initContainers.name: copy-archive
command: import hashlib,pathlib,shutil; p=pathlib.Path('/data/archives/ASTRA-pre-0055-20260906/pharness.db'); assert "sha256:"+hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='sha256:a9d174c3201b68a355adfa6b4d33775469da00a921bf330a557983ced6565a5a'; shutil.copyfile(p,"/scratch/pharness.db"); print("Verified current archive copied into isolated temporary storage")

initContainers.name: migrate-reader
command: pharness-api > /scratch/api.log 2>&1 & reader_pid=$!; trap 'kill "$reader_pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT; ready=false; for check in $(seq 1 30); do if curl --silent --fail --max-time 1 http://127.0.0.1:4777/health >/scratch/health.json; then ready=true; break; fi; kill -0 "$reader_pid"; sleep 1; done; test "$ready" = true; cat /scratch/health.json; kill "$reader_pid"; wait "$reader_pid" || true; trap - EXIT

containers.name: verify-migration
command:
import sqlite3,json,pathlib,hashlib
root=pathlib.Path('/data/archives/ASTRA-pre-0055-20260906')
original=sqlite3.connect("file:"+str(root/"pharness.db")+"?mode=ro",uri=True)
changed=sqlite3.connect("file:/scratch/pharness.db?mode=ro",uri=True)
assert "sha256:"+hashlib.sha256((root/"pharness.db").read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='sha256:a9d174c3201b68a355adfa6b4d33775469da00a921bf330a557983ced6565a5a'
assert changed.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]=="ok"
assert changed.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall()==[]
versions=changed.execute("SELECT version,success FROM _sqlx_migrations ORDER BY version").fetchall()
assert len(versions)==55 and versions[-1]==(55,1) and all(v[1]==1 for v in versions)
def quote(s): return '"'+s.replace('"','""')+'"'
def default(v):
 if isinstance(v,bytes): return {"sqlite_blob_hex":v.hex()}
 raise TypeError(type(v).__name__)
def fingerprint(db,table,columns,where=""):
 h=hashlib.sha256(); n=0
 sql="SELECT "+",".join(map(quote,columns))+" FROM "+quote(table)+where+" ORDER BY "+",".join(map(quote,columns))
 for row in db.execute(sql):
  h.update((json.dumps(list(row),sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False,default=default)+"\n").encode()); n+=1
 return {"columns":columns,"rows":n,"sha256":h.hexdigest()}
preserved={}
tables=[r[0] for r in original.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name")]
for table in tables:
 columns=[r[1] for r in original.execute("PRAGMA table_info("+quote(table)+")")]
 before=fingerprint(original,table,columns)
 after=fingerprint(changed,table,columns," WHERE version <= 54" if table=="_sqlx_migrations" else "")
 assert before==after,("original data changed",table,before,after)
 preserved[table]=after
assert changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM work_items WHERE workflow_policy_json IS NOT NULL OR workflow_policy_hash IS NOT NULL").fetchone()[0]==0
for table in ['hosted_reconciliations','hosted_operations','hosted_operation_locks']:
 assert changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM "+table).fetchone()[0]==0
assert changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM deployment_intents WHERE delivery_stage != 'legacy'").fetchone()[0]==0
assert all(json.loads(row[0]) == {"kind":"full_qualification"} for row in changed.execute("SELECT scope_json FROM inference_evaluations"))
health=json.loads(pathlib.Path("/scratch/health.json").read_text())
print(json.dumps({"schema_version":"pharness.dev/live-copy-migration-evidence/v1alpha1","integrity":"ok","foreign_key_violations":0,"maximum_migration":55,"applied_migrations":len(versions),"source_migration_unchanged":original.execute("SELECT max(version) FROM _sqlx_migrations").fetchone()[0],"archive_sha256":'sha256:a9d174c3201b68a355adfa6b4d33775469da00a921bf330a557983ced6565a5a',"all_original_columns_identical":True,"preserved_tables":len(preserved),"original_column_fingerprints":preserved,"hosted_rows":0,"runtime_health":health,"runtime_image":'registry.lucas.engineering/pharness-runtime@sha256:270abac12bdf9505b042855b5a7abb1369562e8087382eaec537822332b0b2db',"source_revision":'92f8f1b8e98dd45d0a01e030aeb99ef9bcf95267',"scope":"isolated current-database clone; real API migrator; no live database writes"}))
